summary: More community.windows modules redirect to ansible.windows (win_eventlog, win_feature_info, win_firewall, win_hosts, win_hotfix, win_http_proxy), and win_iis_* modules are deprecated in favor of microsoft.iis.

answer_card.title: community.windows IIS modules move to microsoft.iis
answer_card.answer_md:
Redirected to `ansible.windows` (redirect removed in 4.0.0): `win_eventlog`, `win_feature_info`, `win_file_compression`, `win_firewall`, `win_hosts`, `win_hotfix`, `win_http_proxy`.

IIS modules, removed in 4.0.0:
- `win_iis_virtualdirectory` → `microsoft.iis.virtual_directory`
- `win_iis_webapplication` → `microsoft.iis.web_application`
- `win_iis_webapppool` → `microsoft.iis.web_app_pool`
- `win_iis_webbinding` → `microsoft.iis.website`
- `win_iis_website` → `microsoft.iis.website`
